description: Immutable data class representing a collection sheet for join liability groups in Fineract, including loan products, savings products, groups, attendance options, and payment types.

classes.name: JLGCollectionSheetData
classes.description: Immutable data object for join liability group's collection sheet, containing due date, loan products, savings products, groups, attendance options, and payment options.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a new JLGCollectionSheetData instance with specified date, loan products, groups, attendance options, and payment types.

methods.name: withSavingsProducts
methods.description: Creates a new JLGCollectionSheetData instance including savings products, based on an existing instance.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the due date of the collection sheet.

methods.name: getLoanProducts
methods.description: Returns the collection of loan products.
